mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notice_read (noticeid, studentid, teacherid, readtime) VALUES (#{noticeid}, #{studentid}, #{teacherid}, #{readtime})
INSERT IGNORE INTO notice_read (homeworkid, studentid, readtime) VALUES (#{homeworkid}, #{studentid}, #{readtime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notice_read WHERE homeworkid = #{homeworkid} AND studentid = #{studentid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_read WHERE noticeid = #{noticeid} AND studentid IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_read WHERE noticeid = #{noticeid} AND teacherid IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_read WHERE homeworkid = #{homeworkid} AND studentid IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.studentid) FROM student s INNER JOIN homework h ON h.homeworkid = #{homeworkid} INNER JOIN courseclass cc ON h.courseid = cc.courseid AND s.classid = cc.classid
SELECT noticeid FROM notice_read WHERE studentid = #{studentid} AND noticeid IS NOT NULL
